description:
Power over democracy is increasingly negotiated in closed-door meetings between governments and technology companies, not just at the ballot box. Drawing on first-hand experience advising platforms and policymakers in high-stakes environments, Alexis Crews exposes this “Invisible War” over algorithms, surveillance, and “safety”—and shows how leaders and citizens together can build practical guardrails that protect people, strengthen institutions, and keep democracy a shared project in the digital age. 

Alexis Camille Crews is a technology governance and democracy strategist who advises global technology companies, governments, and civil society on election integrity, surveillance, and the responsible use of AI. She has worked with organizations including Meta, Google, Accenture, and the Council on Foreign Relations, helping senior leaders design guardrails for technology in some of the world’s most politically sensitive and high-risk environments. description:
Steve Haupt explores how to stay relevant in a rapidly changing world shaped by AI.  
He shows that success is about updating the mental models that guide how we think.

With talks and hands-on AI projects, he makes complex AI topics clear, practical, and high-quality. author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this thought-provoking talk, Prof. Sarbajit Banerjee reveals the hidden reality behind the batteries powering our phones, laptops, and electric vehicles. From lithium to cobalt, the clean energy revolution depends on minerals extracted at immense human and environmental cost. As global demand for batteries surges, critical resources are fueling community displacement and ethical dilemmas.
But this future is not inevitable. Prof. Banerjee outlines solutions and challenges us to rethink what kind of energy transition we truly want to build. Prof. Dr. Sarbajit Banerjee is a professor of chemistry at ETH Zürich and leads the Laboratory for Battery Science at the Paul Scherrer Institute. His research focuses on developing and understanding advanced materials for energy storage and electrochemical systems. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Will the energy transition be the mineral transition? | Sarbajit Banerjee | TEDxHeilbronn

Startuplar ve yenilikçi iş modelleri üzerine edindiği deneyimle pazarlama, büyüme ve strateji tasarımında güçlü bir uzmanlık geliştirmiştir. Kurucu ortağı olduğu Puzzle Growth ile girişimlere ve ölçeklenme aşamasındaki şirketlere büyüme stratejileri, pazarlama çözümleri ve sürdürülebilir gelişim modelleri sunar. Strateji ve organizasyonel gelişim odağındaki içerikleriyle ekiplerin daha verimli ve odaklı çalışmasına kat
title: Bitirmeme Stratejisi | Cemal Atakan Parlak | TEDxAselsan MTAL Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the solutions we import are the very things holding us back?

After working across more than 20 countries and engaging at global forums, Timothy Timbiti began to notice a pattern: many of the world’s biggest development conversations overlook one critical variable; context.

In this data-driven and visionary talk, Timothy explores Africa’s demographic trajectory, the explosive growth of youth populations, and the intersection of policy, technology, and entrepreneurship. He argues that innovation without policy awareness is risk, and that technology without contextual grounding can create unintended consequences.

Drawing from his work in digital transformation and advisory roles across sectors, he introduces a forward-looking framework: align policy, leverage technology, and architect ecosystems — not just businesses.

Timothy Timbiti is a digital transformation strategist with over 15 years of experience partnering with governments, NGOs, and institutions across 20+ countries
title: Africa’s Future Needs a Custom Blueprint | Timothy Timbiti | TEDxMakerere University Business School

Every year, medication errors claim over 200,000 lives and cost half a trillion dollars — not because we lack data, but because that data remains fragmented and underused. In this inspiring talk, Dr. Lusia Fomuso reveals how artificial intelligence is stepping in as a powerful healthcare partner: personalizing treatments through pharmacogenomics, catching hidden risks before they harm patients, and freeing people from the overwhelming burden of managing complex medications. Discover why AI isn’t here to replace doctors and pharmacists, it’s here to make them unstoppable.

 Dr. Lusia Fomuso, PharmD, DBA, MPH, CPGx, is a Medical Science specialist with years of expertise in pharmacogenomics, medication safety, and digital health innovation. As a now 3X TEDx speaker and published author, she advocates for precision medicine and AI-driven healthcare solutions to empower patients and providers. title: Artificial intelligence as a healthcare partner | Dr. Lusia Fomuso | TEDxUTD Salon

In a powerful talk, Art of Shaving founder Eric Malka reveals a counterintuitive truth — that clarity about what not to do can be more transformative than knowing exactly what to do. Eric Malka is a visionary entrepreneur, business operator, and published author with more than 30 years’ experience in the luxury Branded Consumer-Packaged Goods arena. He is best known as the co-founder of The Art of Shaving, a brand that redefined men's grooming. 

Under his leadership as co-founder and former CEO, Eric developed The Art of Shaving from a start-up to an internationally recognized men’s grooming brand. In 2009, The Art of Shaving was acquired by Gillette/Procter & Gamble, and Eric was tapped by P&G to continue in his role as CEO through the end of 2010.
